uzakErisim.aciklama:
The device connects AUTOMATICALLY — you do not need to enter an IP.
📡 Same Wi-Fi → found instantly via mDNS.
🌐 Different network → after pairing once, it connects automatically to the device's current address in the cloud.
The options below are only a MANUAL fallback if the automatic connection fails.

veriTasima.aciklama: Patient records, session history and AI analysis history are exported to a single ENCRYPTED file.
veriTasima.aciklamaArastirma: ALL records on this device — clinical and research: patient / subject cards, session history and AI analysis history — are exported to a single ENCRYPTED file.
veriTasima.disaAktarEtiketi: Export clinical data to an encrypted file
veriTasima.disaAktarEtiketiArastirma: Export all records on this device to an encrypted file
veriTasima.geriYukleUyari: Restoring DELETES the existing session and analysis history if there are records on this device. Patient cards are not deleted.
veriTasima.geriYukleUyariArastirma: Restoring DELETES the existing session and analysis history (clinical and research) if there are records on this device. Patient / subject cards are not deleted.
veriTasima.parolaUyarisi: It is restored on the new computer with the same password. The file cannot be opened without the password — if you lose the password, the backup cannot be recovered.

yedek.geriYukleOnay:
If there are records on this device, the existing treatment history (sessions, coil runs, sensor data, AI analyses) will be DELETED and replaced with the backup. Patient cards are not deleted: cards of patients not in the backup remain, but their session history on this device is deleted.

Continue?
